title: Lifespan Integration for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder From an Auto Accident
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate if lifespan integration (LI) therapy reduces posttraumatic stress symptoms following a motor vehicle accident (MVA) trauma
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Involved in or witnessed a car accident at least 6 months ago.
* PTSD or distress or impairment in important areas of functioning following the car accident

Exclusion Criteria:

* moderate or severe head injury
* current mental health treatment for the MVA-related problem
* severe chronic pre-injury mental health problems
